ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) distribution; estimated 0.05:1 ratio of high-intensity white/light-grey pixels (scars/barnacles) to the black/dark-grey fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark grey/black base across both lobes; high-contrast white focal clusters at distal tips; sparse, isolated white point-like distributions across the right lobe surface area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped median notch; calculated interior angle of approximately 52 degrees; bounding-box depth is approximately 15% of total vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the trailing edge; pixel-amplitude variations of 5-15 pixels; edge topography is extremely rugged at distal tips due to bio-fouling.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit a strong upward-sweeping concave trajectory along the trailing edge boundary terminating in sharp distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of roughly circular high-contrast white markers at both left and right distal tips; sparse individual circular scars on the right lobe interior.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple parallel, diagonal white linear marks (rake marks) on the right lobe, oriented at roughly 40 degrees from the vertical axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at both distal tips presenting as thick, brownish-white irregular masses; prominent linear rake marks on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The heavy barnacle encrustation on the distal tips significantly distorts the natural geometric silhouette of the fluke margins.
